# Overview

```{python}
#| include: false
#| label: imports 
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd

from altair.datasets import data

import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True)

```



```{python}
#| include: false
#| label: Download data center datasets 
from zipfile import ZipFile
import requests
from io import BytesIO

zip_file_url = 'https://epoch.ai/data/data_centers/data_centers.zip'
r = requests.get(zip_file_url, stream=True)

z = ZipFile(BytesIO(r.content))
z.extractall(path="data/data_centers")


data_centers = pd.read_csv("data/data_centers/data_centers.csv")

data_center_chillers = pd.read_csv("data/data_centers/data_center_chillers.csv")



```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Current total capital cost (2025 USD billions)"
#| color: primary

dict(
  value = float(data_centers.agg({"Current total capital cost (2025 USD billions)": 'sum'}).values[0])
)

```

# Altair demo

```{python}
# load a sample dataset as a pandas DataFrame
cars = data.cars()

# make the chart
alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x='Horsepower',
    y='Miles_per_Gallon',
    color='Origin',
).interactive()
```
